body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Mio launched its breakthrough navigation software 'Mio Spirit' at CES 2009, which boasts a simple and intuitive user interface, an industry first 'Explore Mode' presenting all nearby Points-of-Interest(POI) at a glance, and a 'Capture Button' to record favorite routes, locations, and voice memos.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
